name: GTE staged branch-and-resume (absolute sigma segments with step stamps)
plain: Lets a run stop part-way and later continue or branch. SigmaSegment cuts sigmas[start : end+1] out of one full schedule, so adjacent stages share their boundary sigma and step numbers stay absolute (core SplitSigmas cuts what is left over); bad ranges raise instead of clamping. StampStep writes a stage's end step, and optionally its end sigma, into the LATENT dict as gte_step / gte_sigma and refuses to go backwards; ResumeStep reads gte_step back as the next stage's start_step, with a fallback. CandidateSelect takes one item out of a batch, keeps its batch_index and reports origin_seed + index. The sampler maths itself is unchanged.
math:
segment(σ, a, b) = σ[a : b+1], requires 0 ≤ a < b ≤ len(σ) − 1; also outputs σ[a] and σ[b].
stamp: latent′ = latent ∪ {gte_step: b, gte_sigma: σ[b]}; error if b < the existing gte_step.
resume: a_next = latent.gte_step, else fallback.
select: latent′ = item i, batch_index = [batch_index[i]] or [i], seed = origin_seed + i.

props.params: SigmaSegment start_step=0, end_step=4; StampStep step=0, sigma optional; ResumeStep fallback=0; CandidateSelect index=0, origin_seed=0
